ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a circle with D as the center, A and C are respectively at the left and right ends of the circle, A, D, C are collinear; point F is located on the lower semicircle, and is between the lower semicircular arc from A to C. The problem gives m arc CF = 60. Reasoning: Because D is the center of the circle, and A, D, C are collinear and A, C are on the circle, AC is a diameter. The measure of the lower semicircular arc AC subtended by the diameter is 180°. The lower semicircular arc AC is divided by point F into arc AF and arc FC, so m arc AF = 180° - m arc FC = 180° - 60° = 120°.

raw_record.question_text: In $\odot D$, $\overline{D E} \cong \overline{E C}$, $m\widehat{C F}=60$, and $\overline{D E} \perp \overline{E C}$. Find $m\widehat{A F}$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram first: D is the center of the circle and A, D, C are collinear with A and C on the circle, so AC is a diameter. F lies on the lower semicircle between A and C, and the small arc CF is part of that same lower semicircle. From the text, use m arc CF = 60. Since a semicircle measures 180 degrees, the lower arc AC is split as arc AF + arc FC, so m arc AF = 180 - 60 = 120.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是以 D 为圆心的圆，A 和 C 分别在圆的左右两端，A、D、C 共线；点 F 位于下半圆上，且在 A 到 C 的下半圆弧之间。题目给出 m弧CF = 60。推理：因为 D 是圆心，且 A、D、C 共线并且 A、C 在圆上，所以 AC 是直径。直径所对的下半圆弧 AC 的度数是 180°。下半圆弧 AC 被点 F 分成弧 AF 和弧 FC，所以 m弧AF = 180° - m弧FC = 180° - 60° = 120°。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram first: E lies on chord BC, DE meets BC at E, A-D-C is a straight line, and the points go around the circle in the order A, B, C, F. From the text, DE ≅ EC and DE ⟂ EC, so triangle DEC is a right isosceles triangle and ∠DCE = ∠CDE = 45 degrees. Since CE lies along CB and CD lies along CA, ∠BCA = 45 degrees, so by the inscribed angle theorem, arc BA = 90. Also, because a perpendicular from the center D to chord BC bisects the chord, BE = EC; with DE = EC, triangle DBE is right isosceles, so ∠BDE = 45. Thus central angle BDC = 45 + 45 = 90, giving arc BC = 90. Now subtract the known arcs from the full circle: arc AF = 360 - arc AB - arc BC - arc CF = 360 - 90 - 90 - 60 = 120.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是以 D 为圆心的圆，A、D、C 在同一条水平直线上；B 在圆的上方，F 在圆的右下方，圆周点按 A、B、C、F 的顺序排列。线段 BC 是一条弦，E 在 BC 上，DE 从圆心 D 垂到 BC，并且图中标出了 DE 与 EC 相关的位置关系。推理：由题意 DE ≅ EC 且 DE ⟂ EC，所以 △DEC 是直角等腰三角形，∠DCE = ∠CDE = 45°。因为 CE 与 CB 共线，CD 与 CA 共线，所以 ∠BCA = 45°。∠BCA 是圆周角，截得弧 BA，因此 m弧BA = 2 × 45° = 90°。又因为 D 是圆心，DE 垂直弦 BC，所以 DE 平分弦 BC，即 BE = EC。结合 DE = EC，可得 BE = DE，所以 △DBE 也是直角等腰三角形，∠BDE = 45°。于是中心角 ∠BDC = ∠BDE + ∠EDC = 45° + 45° = 90°，所以 m弧BC = 90°。已知 m弧CF = 60°，整圆为 360°，且圆周顺序为 A-B-C-F，所以 m弧AF = 360° - 90° - 90° - 60° = 120°。
